fact: Interior minister Velonjara Tiaray Rakotonandrasana says nearly 5 million people were enrolled in phase I of Izaho tokana biometric enrolment, about 15% of the 32.7 million population (computed), with reconciliation against the central base still under way.
Government figures say 2.6 million people were enrolled in the digital ID system in two months, about 8% of the 32.7 million population (computed from the population given).
The January 2026 pilot enrolled nearly 130,000 people, about 0.4% of Madagascar's 32.7 million (share computed from the held population), per Biometric Update.

Authorities said more than six million people had been enrolled in Madagascar's biometric ID scheme by June 2026, about 18% of 32.7 million people (share computed from the population given), against a 12 million target.
More than 3.25 million people are enrolled for the ID under PRODIGY, about 9.9% of the 32.7 million population (divided by the population held, not stated in the document).
The World Bank says PRODIGY had enrolled over 3.25 million adults by 10 June 2026, about 10% of the 32.7 million population (computed from the population given).
The terms of reference say the IDMS has not entered mass enrolment and no significant volume of biometric or identity data is yet registered in production.
